about: Targets ActionAgent (action_gate@v1 + action_agent@v1) must reach on action_golden.json: extraction F1 over emitted candidates (silent and surfaced) and the Brier score of their confidence against matched/unmatched. Measured from the current defaults on their first live run; a new prompt must at least match F1 and not exceed the Brier ceiling (the measured score plus 0.02 headroom for run-to-run variance). The two ADR-0039 never-record cases (unmeasured_cases) were added after that run and action_agent@v2 / action_gate@v2 have not been measured live yet: re-run `EVAL_LIVE=1 pytest -m eval tests/test_decision_action_eval.py` before trusting min_f1 for them.
